THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
077
Behind the image
33 / Snow Mink
REFERENCE 5787.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 026
Art direction: Winter travel snapshot, camel and cream tones, red lip accent, bright sunlight.
Photorealistic vertical winter travel portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with long, wavy
dark hair and light natural freckles, wearing a round tan faux-fur hat, a gray ribbed turtleneck and
an oversized camel wool coat with wide lapels. Rosy cold-kissed cheeks, bold matte red lips, calm
direct gaze to the camera. Bright winter sunlight on a snowy mountain trail with rocky cliffs,
snow-covered slopes and bare trees blurred in the background, warm camel and cream tones
against cool white snow, crisp detail, natural smartphone-style framing, no text or logos.
34 / Crossing Blue
REFERENCE 5786.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 027
Art direction: Metropolitan editorial, bright midday sun, crisp natural makeup, saturated city
bokeh.
Photorealistic vertical street-style editorial portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with
shoulder-length dark brown hair, a few strands blown across her face by the wind, natural makeup
with soft rosy lips and a calm, direct gaze. She wears an oversized navy tailored blazer over a plain
black crew-neck top. Standing at a busy modern city crossing in bright midday sun, the
background softly blurred into glass skyscrapers, colorful abstract billboards with no readable
text, and green trees. Natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, warm sunlight with
cool navy tones, contemporary fashion magazine style, no text, watermark or logos.
